privacy.title: Inqubomgomo Yobumfihlo
privacy.intro: I-NEXUS iphatha ikhaya lakho elihlakaniphile ikakhulukazi kunethiwekhi yakho yasendaweni. Le nqubomgomo ichaza ngokucacile ukuthi siyiphatha kanjani idatha, kungani nokuthi kuphi uma udala i-akhawunti.

ul: I-akhawunti iyadingeka ukuze usebenzise i-NEXUS. Imiyalo yamadivayisi isasebenza kunethiwekhi yakho yasendaweni; ayithunyelwa nge-cloud yomkhiqizi.
Izilungiselelo zakho, uhlu lwamadivayisi nomlando wengxoxo kugcinwa ku-cloud ukuze zifane kuwo wonke amadivayisi.
Asiyidayisi idatha yakho, asiyisebenzisi ezikhangisweni futhi asikwenzeli iphrofayili.

Ukufinyelela kumakrofoni kuyazikhethela futhi kusetshenziswa kuphela uma uthinta imakrofoni engxoxweni ye-NEXUS AI; irekhodi liguqulelwa embhalweni futhi aligcinwa. Ikhamera ivulwa kuphela ukuskena amakhodi e-QR futhi isithombe asikaze siphume kudivayisi yakho.

p: Umphathi wedatha yi-NEXUS. Xhumana nathi: nexus.smarthome.app@gmail.com

ul: I-akhawunti: ikheli lakho le-imeyili futhi (uma linikeziwe) igama lakho. Ngokungena nge-Google, i-imeyili negama lephrofayili elinikezwa yi-Google. Iphasiwedi yakho igcinwa kuphela njenge-hash eya ngohlangothi olulodwa ku-Supabase Auth; asikwazi ukuyibona.

Idatha ye-app evumelanisiwe (kuphela uma ungenile): igama nesithombe sephrofayili, izilungiselelo zethimu/ulimi/amayunithi, amalungu omndeni, izigcawu nokuzenzakalelayo, amakhadi akhethekile, umlando wengxoxo ye-NEXUS AI nesibali sokusetshenziswa, irekhodi lemicimbi, okuncamelayo kwendawo yasekhaya/isimo sezulu nohlu lwamadivayisi owengeze (igama, ikamelo, iphrothokholi, ikheli lenethiwekhi yasendaweni, isimo sokugcina).
Ukubhalisela (uma uthenge i-NEXUS+): i-imeyili, uhlelo, isimo, ukuphela kwenkathi ne-ID yobulungu be-Whop. Imininingwane yekhadi lakho iphathwa yi-Whop kuphela futhi ayifiki kithi.
Imilayezo yokweseka: i-imeyili yakho nomlayezo uma usibhalela.
Amalogi obuchwepheshe: amalogi okungena namaphutha (kuhlanganise ikheli le-IP) agcinwa isikhashana ababoneleli bethu bokusingatha nobokuqinisekisa.

p: Ukuphatha i-akhawunti yakho, ukuvumelanisa idatha yakho phakathi kwamadivayisi, ukunikeza ukubhalisela kwakho nokunikeza usizo (ukufezekiswa kwenkontileka); ukugcina insizakalo iphephile nokuvimbela ukusetshenziswa kabi (inzuzo evumelekile); nokudluliselwa phesheya, imvume yakho ecacile (bheka ngezansi).

I-NEXUS AI inezingxenye ezimbili. (1) Imiyalo yamadivayisi (ukukhanyisa isibani, ukuqalisa isigcawu, ukubuza isimo) iphethwe ngasendaweni kudivayisi yakho futhi ayithunyelwa ku-cloud. (2) Imilayezo engeyona imiyalo yamadivayisi, njengengxoxo evamile nemibuzo, ithunyelwa ku-Cloudflare Workers AI ukuze iphendulwe; amagama, izinhlobo namakamelo amadivayisi akho afakwa njengomongo. Imininingwane ye-akhawunti yakho, i-imeyili nendawo akuthunyelwa. Asisebenzisi lokhu okuqukethwe ukuqeqesha amamodeli e-AI; i-Cloudflare iyakuphatha ukuze inikeze insizakalo. Uma uthanda, ungasebenzisa imiyalo yamadivayisi kuphela engxoxweni. Uma ungenile, umlando wengxoxo yakho uvumelaniswa ne-akhawunti yakho njengezinye izilungiselelo zakho.

Okokufaka ngezwi: uma uthinta inkinobho yemakrofoni engxoxweni ye-NEXUS AI, inkulumo yakho iguqulelwa embhalweni. Ku-browser (Chrome/Edge) kuqala kusetshenziswa insizakalo yokuqaphela inkulumo ye-browser uqobo; uma ingafinyeleleki, noma ezinhlelweni zekhompyutha nezeselula, irekhodi elifushane lithunyelwa kuphela ku-Cloudflare Workers AI (Whisper) ukuze liguqulelwe embhalweni, aligcinwa futhi alilondolozwa ku-akhawunti yakho. Umbhalo oguqulelwe ubekwa kuphela ebhokisini lokufaka lengxoxo futhi awuthunyelwandawo kuze kube uthinta ukuthumela.

ul: Supabase: ukuqinisekisa, isizindalwazi nama-imeyili esistimu.
Cloudflare: ukusingatha iwebhusayithi; Cloudflare Workers AI yezimpendulo zengxoxo ye-NEXUS AI nokuguqula inkulumo ibe umbhalo.
Whop: ukukhokha kokubhalisela nokukhipha ama-invoyisi.
Google: ukungena nge-Google futhi (nge-Gmail) ama-imeyili okuqinisekisa / okusetha kabusha iphasiwedi.
GitHub: ukusabalalisa abafaki.
Open-Meteo: idolobha / izixhumanisi ezilinganiselwe zesimo sezulu.
OpenStreetMap / Nominatim: amamephu nokusesha izindawo; Unsplash: ezinye izithombe zokuhlala.

BigDataCloud: ukuthola igama lendawo ngezixhumanisi (okuhlala uma i-Nominatim ingafinyeleleki; futhi kusetshenziswa uma ukhetha indawo yasekhaya lakho). Lesi sevisi sithola izixhumanisi ezinembile zendawo oyikhethayo noma etholiwe.
p: Amaseva alababoneleli angase abe ngaphandle kwe-Türkiye. Ngokudala i-akhawunti kanye/noma ngokukhokha unikeza imvume ecacile yokuba idatha yakho idluliselwe kubo naphesheya; ungayiphakamisa imvume ngokususa i-akhawunti yakho.
Iwebhusayithi yethu ayisebenzisi amakhukhi futhi ayinazo izilandeli zokuhlaziya noma zezikhangiso. I-app igcina izilungiselelo zakho esitoreji sendawo sedivayisi yakho (localStorage).

Sigcina idatha yakho inqobo nje uma i-akhawunti yakho ivuliwe. Ukuze susise i-akhawunti yakho nedatha, bhalela ku-nexus.smarthome.app@gmail.com; sizoqeda isicelo ezinsukwini ezingu-30 (ngaphandle kwamarekhodi okubhalisela okufanele siwagcine ngokomthetho). Ku-app, vula Izilungiselelo, bese Ukuphepha kwe-akhawunti, futhi usebenzise Susa i-akhawunti yami. Uma iseva ingakwazi ukuqeda, isikrini siyakusho.

Ngaphansi koMthetho waseTürkiye onguNombolo 6698 (KVKK) isigaba 11 futhi, lapho kusebenza, i-GDPR, ungabuza ukuthi idatha yakho iyaphathwa yini, uyifinyelele, uyilungise, uyisuse, uphikise ukuphathwa futhi ucele ukuhanjiswa kwayo. Bhalela ku-nexus.smarthome.app@gmail.com. Ungakwazi futhi ukukhalaza kuMgcinimandla Wokuvikelwa Kwedatha Yomuntu waseTürkiye.

Uxhumo luvikelwe nge-TLS. Isizindalwazi siphoqelela ukulawula ukufinyelela ezingeni lomugqa: umsebenzisi ngamunye angafunda futhi abhale idatha yakhe kuphela. Asikho isistimu ephephe ngokuphelele; sincoma iphasiwedi eqinile nokugcina amadivayisi akho esesikhathini.
Amadivayisi ahlakaniphile owaxhumanisayo (isb. Shelly, WLED, ESPHome) angakhuluma namaseva abakhiqizi bawo ngaphansi kwenqubomgomo yabo yobumfihlo. I-NEXUS ayabelani idatha yakho nalabo bakhiqizi.
I-NEXUS ayiqondiswe ezinganeni ezingaphansi kweminyaka engu-13 futhi asiyiqoqi ngamabomu idatha yazo.
Singavuselela le nqubomgomo; sizamemezela izinguquko ezibalulekile ku-app noma ku-iwebhusayithi.
Imibuzo: nexus.smarthome.app@gmail.com

terms.title: Imigomo Yensizakalo
terms.intro: Ngokulanda, ukufaka noma ukusebenzisa i-app ye-NEXUS nezinsizakalo ezihlobene («Izinsizakalo») wamukela le migomo. Izinsizakalo zinikezwa yi-NEXUS. Xhumana nathi: nexus.smarthome.app@gmail.com

p: Sikunika ilayisense yomuntu siqu, engeyona eyokukhetha, engadluliseleki, ekwazi ukukhanselwa yokusebenzisa isofthiwe ye-NEXUS emadivayisini onawo noma owalawulayo, ukuze usebenzise ukuzenzakalelisa kwasekhaya komuntu siqu, okungezona zebhizinisi. Awukwazi ukuyisabalalisa, ukuyiqasha, ukuyidayisa, ukuyinika abanye ilayisense, ukuyihlaziya ngokuhlehlayo, noma ukuyisebenzisela ukwakha umkhiqizo ophikisana ngqo ne-NEXUS. Izingxenye zezinhlangothi zesithathu zingaphansi kwamalayisense azo.

Ukusebenzisa i-NEXUS kudinga i-akhawunti. Unesibopho sokugcina imininingwane yakho ilungile nephasiwedi yakho iphephile, nomsebenzi ongaphansi kwe-akhawunti yakho. Singamisa noma sivale ama-akhawunti aphula le migomo.

ul: I-NEXUS iyithuluzi lokwenza lula; ungayethembi yodwa emisebenzini ebalulekile njengomlilo, igesi, impilo noma ukuphepha kwempilo.
Unesibopho semiyalo ethunyelwa emadivayisini akho nokuphepha kwenethiwekhi yakho. Gcina i-firmware yamadivayisi nezilungiselelo zerutha zisesikhathini.
Ngenxa yokuphepha, izikhiya azikwazi ukuvulwa engxoxweni.

p: Uhlelo lwamahhala luhlanganisa amakhredithi e-NEXUS AI angu-30 ngosuku; ukubhalisela kwe-NEXUS+ kuhlanganisa angu-2,000 ngenyanga. Amakhredithi awadluliseleki, awakwazi ukushintshaniswa ngemali futhi asethwa kabusha ekupheleni kwenkathi. I-NEXUS AI ingenza amaphutha; ukuhlola imiphumela kuwumsebenzi wakho.

ul: Ububanzi: I-NEXUS+ inikeza amakhredithi e-NEXUS AI angu-2,000 ngenyanga futhi ivula ukungeza amadivayisi amasha ngokuxhumana okuthuthukile (Home Assistant). Uma ukubhalisela kuphela, amadivayisi osuwengeziwe aqhubeka nokusebenza; ukungeza amadivayisi amasha ngalokhu kuxhumana kudinga i-NEXUS+ futhi.

Izinhlelo: Ngenyanga neNyakeni, zixakwe nge-TRY e-Türkiye nangeUSD kwenye indawo (okwamanje ngenyanga ₺499.99 / $11.99, Ngonyaka ₺3,999.99 / $89.99). Amanani amanje abonakala ekuhlawuleni; intela ingase ingezwe ekuhlawuleni. Uhlelo lonyaka luhlanganisa ukuzama kwamahhala kwezinsuku ezingu-7 kanti uhlelo lwenyanga lunokuzama kwamahhala kwezinsuku ezingu-3.
Inkokhelo ithathwa nge-Whop. Ukubhalisela kuvuselelwa ngokuzenzakalelayo njalo ngenkathi kuze kube uyakhansela; lapho ukuzama kuphela, inani loluhlelo olukhethile liyakhokhiswa.
Ungakhansela noma nini ku-Billing ku-app noma ku-akhawunti yakho kule webhusayithi. Ukukhansela kuqala ukusebenza ekupheleni kwenkathi yamanje.
Uma ukhokha, sebenzisa ikheli le-imeyili le-akhawunti yakho ye-NEXUS; ukubhalisela kuhlanganiswa naleyo imeyili.
Simemezela izinguquko zamanani okungenani izinsuku ezingu-30 ngaphambi kokuba ziqale ukusebenza; azithinti inkathi yamanje.
Imigomo yokubuyiselwa kwemali isenqubomgomweni Yokubuyiselwa Kwemali Nokukhansela.

p: Singathuthukisa, sishintshe noma simise isikhashana Izinsizakalo ngenxa yokunakekela. Asiqinisekisi insizakalo engaphazamiseki noma engenamaphutha.
Amalungelo kusofthiwe ye-NEXUS, idizayini, uhlobo nokuqukethwe ayeka kumqhubi. Le migomo ikunika kuphela ilayisense engenhla.

Isofthiwe inikezwa «njengoba injalo». Ngezinga eliphezulu elivunyelwa umthetho asinasibopho sokulimala okungaqondile (kuhlanganise ukulahlekelwa kwedatha noma umonakalo emadivayisini noma impahla) okuvela ekusebenziseni Izinsizakalo; isibopho sethu sizonke silinganiselwe emalini oyikhokhele thina ezinyangeni ezingu-12 ezedlule. Amalungelo abathengi angakwazi ukulinganiselwa ngumthetho awathinteki.
Ungavala i-akhawunti yakho noma nini (bheka Inqubomgomo Yobumfihlo). Singaphelisa ukufinyelela kwakho uma uphula le migomo.
Le migomo ilawulwa yimithetho yeRiphabhulikhi yeTürkiye. Njengomthengi ugcina ilungelo lokufinyelela amakomiti okulamula abathengi nezinkantolo zabathengi.
Singavuselela le migomo futhi sizamemezela izinguquko ezibalulekile ku-app noma ku-iwebhusayithi. Ukuqhubeka nokusebenzisa Izinsizakalo ngemuva kwenguquko kusho ukuthi wamukela imigomo emisha.

refund.title: Inqubomgomo Yokubuyiselwa Kwemali Nokukhansela
refund.intro: Le nqubomgomo ichaza imigomo yokuzama, yokukhansela neyokubuyiselwa kwemali yokubhalisela kwe-NEXUS+. Amalungelo akho abathengi esimiso somthetho awathinteki.

p: Uhlelo lonyaka luhlanganisa ukuzama kwamahhala kwezinsuku ezingu-7 kanti uhlelo lwenyanga lunokuzama kwamahhala kwezinsuku ezingu-3. Uma ukhansela ngaphambi kokuba ukuzama kuphele awukhokhiswa. Uma ungakhansele, inani loluhlelo olukhethile liyakhokhiswa lapho ukuzama kuphela.

ul: Ku-app: Plus → Billing → Khansela ekupheleni kwenkathi.
Kuwebhusayithi: ngena → i-akhawunti → khansela ekupheleni kwenkathi.
Ukukhansela kuqala ukusebenza ekupheleni kwenkathi yamanje yokukhokha; ugcina izici ze-NEXUS+ kuze kube yileso sikhathi futhi awukhokhiswa inkathi elandelayo.
Ungacela ukubuyiselwa kwemali ezinsukwini ezingu-14 zenkokhelo yakho yokuqala ngaphandle kokunikeza isizathu; sibuyisela inkokhelo yonke.
Ngokuvuselelwa okuzenzakalelayo, uma ucela ezinsukwini ezingu-3 zosuku lokuvuselelwa sibuyisela inkokhelo yaleyo nkathi.

Ngaphandle kwalezi zikhathi asibuyiseli izinkathi ezisetshenzisiwe, kodwa sizobheka ukubuyisela imali ezimeni ezinezizathu ezifana nokuthi insizakalo ayisebenziseki ngenxa yephutha ngasohlangothini lwethu.
Singenqaba isicelo uma sibona ukusetshenziswa kabi (isibonelo ukubuyiselwa kwemali okuphindaphindwayo ku-akhawunti efanayo).

p: Thumela i-imeyili ku-nexus.smarthome.app@gmail.com nge-imeyili ye-akhawunti yakho ye-NEXUS nesicelo sakho. Ukubuyiselwa kwemali okuvunyiwe kukhishwa nge-Whop kuya endleleni yokukhokha yasekuqaleni; ngokuvamile kuthatha izinsuku zebhizinisi ezingu-5–10 ukuvela, kuye ngebhange lakho.

Le nqubomgomo ayilinganisi amalungelo akho esimiso somthetho ngaphansi koMthetho Wokuvikelwa Kwabathengi waseTürkiye onguNombolo 6502 neMithethonqubo Yezinkontileka Zasebangeni (kuhlanganise ilungelo lokuhoxa nokuhlukile kwalo).
